title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-08
source: MR (Dick Latvala) > DAT > SoundForge (Jim Wise) > CD

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of an epic 11/8/69 show featuring a soaring Main Ten jam and a stellar Dark Star journey.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the explosive jams and rare set list, highlighting the early “Main Ten” improvisation and a breathtaking Dark Star that takes listeners on a memorable journey. The soundboard source is praised for its clear mix, though several reviewers lament missing tracks in the archive version. Overall the performance shines despite the incomplete streaming release.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews award 5 stars and praise the musical performance, while a few note significant missing songs that affect the listening experience; recording quality is reported as solid.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard source; reviewers did not mention audio flaws, indicating a clear and balanced mix despite the archive’s missing portions.

standout_songs: Main Ten (early Playing In The Band)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as outstanding, with a seamless journey from Dark Star into the Main Ten jam and an overall “peak Dead” vibe that captures the band’s metamorphosis in late 1969.
